newsitem.title: USA: NY sees Con Edison, Central Hudson agreements.
newsitem.headline: NY sees Con Edison, Central Hudson agreements.

text.p: The New York Public Service Commission expects settlement agreements to be filed in the next two weeks with Consolidated Edison Co of New York Inc and Central Hudson Gas & Electric Corp.

In a notice the parties in its ongoing restructuring talks with five utilities issued Thursday, the commission said "proposed settlement agreements will be filed on March 11 and March 18, 1997, in the Consolidated Edison and Central Hudson cases, respectively."
The notice also said talks with New York State Electric & Gas Corp, Orange and Rockland Utilities Inc and Rochester Gas and Electric Corp have been extended to March 25.
The March 1 New York Times cited a draft of an agreement between Con Edison and the commission staff calling for immediate rate cuts under the utility's restructuring plan.
In its late September filing in the state's competitive opportunities case, the company had proposed a rate freeze during the transition to deregulated power sales.
